items.title: Avionics Hardware Dev Engineer · Varda Space Industries · El Segundo, CA
bullets: Developed, qualified, and integrated an in-house spacecraft sun sensor with 10× lower cost and 5× shorter lead time than commercial alternatives; baselined for future missions
Own qualification, integration, and anomaly resolution for GNC sensors and actuators across the spacecraft bus and capsule, including sun sensors, star trackers, IMUs, magnetometers, and torque rods
Own development of a high-efficiency TEC thermal-control system and non-invasive Hall-effect position-sensing board for micrometer-scale measurements under bio-compatibility constraints
Developing automated production test software that enables technicians to qualify multiple flight components in parallel, increasing qualification throughput
Co-developed a Xyce-based circuit analysis tool to automate electronics analysis workflows and accelerate hardware development across the avionics team
Mentored an intern through system architecture selection, schematic and layout reviews, hardware debugging and test development of an in-house camera

items.title: Systems Integration Intern · Formlabs · Somerville, MA
bullets: Designed experimental methods and test hardware to characterize thermopile-array IR sensors used in the Fuse X1 across environmental and geometric conditions
Modeled off-axis sensor-pixel projection and developed interactive analysis tools to support sensor alignment and configuration decisions.
Developed Python-based automated test and analysis workflows using NumPy, SciPy, and Jupyter to compare sensor performance across configurations and operating conditions

items.title: Gimbals R&D Intern · Freefly Systems · Woodinville, WA
bullets: Developed a C++ motion-control firmware release for the MōVI Pro gimbal using IMU feedback, gimbal dynamics, and user inputs for professional cinema applications
Derived forward and inverse kinematics for a non-orthogonal gimbal architecture to evaluate design feasibility and identify gimbal-lock mitigation strategies
Developed the user interface and interactive documentation for the beta release, translating complex motion-control parameters into an intuitive configuration workflow for end users

items.title: Low-Cost Depth Sensor for Deep-Water Research · M.Eng. Thesis
items.description: Designed and pressure-tested a custom magnetic-displacement depth sensor and embedded electronics package for Woods Hole Oceanographic Institute instruments operating to 2,000 m depth

items.title: Drone Development Member · Cornell University
